customer_name.description: Customer's full name (First Last). Example: 'John Smith'

address.description: Full service address including street, city, state, and zip. Example: '123 Main Street, Painesville, OH 44077'

issue.description: REQUIRED: Full description of customer's problem. Include: what's wrong, equipment type (AC, furnace, boiler), system age, how long problem occurring, vulnerable occupants (baby, elderly). Example: 'AC not working at all, no air from vents, 10 year old system, started yesterday, has baby in home'

appointment_time.description: Requested appointment window. Use exactly: 'morning 8-12' for morning, 'afternoon 12-4' for afternoon, or 'asap' for emergency same-day service

is_emergency.description: Set to TRUE for No A/C or No Heat situations with vulnerable occupants. Set to FALSE for minor issues, maintenance, tune-ups, quotes.

referral_source.description: IMPORTANT: Pass the CUSTOMER'S EXACT WORDS when they answered 'How did you hear about us?' - NOT your acknowledgment like 'Perfect' or 'Great'. Examples of correct values: 'Google', 'my friend John', 'I saw your yard sign', 'Facebook ad', 'used you before'. If customer didn't say, use 'not specified'.
